Supporting Documents
Transcript / Certificate
Compulsory - The full and final version of the award parchment, academic transcripts, and the official grading system/explanatory notes for the transcripts of all undergraduate and postgraduate degrees obtained.
Academic Referee's Report
Compulsory - two academic referee reports. Applicants are expected to input the official work email addresses of their academic referees so they can receive the online referee reports for completion. The proposed Chief Supervisor and Co-supervisor(s) cannot serve as referees.
Curriculum Vitae
Compulsory - The applicant's curriculum vitae detailing academic qualifications, publications (including the DOI, latest JCR journal impact factor, and ranking by journal impact factor for all disciplines), and merits/awards obtained at the regional, national, or international level.
Research Proposal
Compulsory - A research proposal in standard format (link).
Personal Statement
Compulsory - A vision statement up to 1,500 words.
